description: This Java source file defines the JobPoller class, which manages the queuing, scheduling, and execution of jobs within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for thread pool configuration, job registration, polling job managers for jobs, and managing the job execution lifecycle.

classes.name: JobPoller
classes.description: Main class responsible for polling job managers, managing thread pools, and executing scheduled jobs within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JobInvokerThreadFactory
classes.description: Inner class implementing ThreadFactory for naming job queue threads.

classes.name: JobManagerPoller
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to periodically poll registered JobManagers for new jobs to enqueue.

methods.name: createThreadPoolExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures the ThreadPoolExecutor based on service configuration or default values.

methods.name: createPriorityComparator
methods.description: Creates a comparator to sort jobs by priority and start time.

methods.name: pollWaitTime
methods.description: Retrieves the configured wait time between polling cycles.

methods.name: queueSize
methods.description: Gets the maximum queue size from the configuration.
